rationale: After a brief shallow dip to $13.16 that remained well above session VWAP ($13.13) and the $13.11 invalidation level, price has printed four consecutive higher 1-minute closes to reclaim the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.28). Meanwhile, the broader market is bouncing off its lows (SPY improving from -3.94% at entry to -3.44%), providing an additional tailwind for this high-relative-volume leader to push toward the $13.70 target.
